title: Alianza para el Progreso
goal: Read the concrete numbers, country-by-country results, and quiet early-1970s wind-down of the Alliance for Progress, beyond its 1961 launch.

items: State the funding and growth goals agreed at Punta del Este in 1961.
Compare how different countries' results varied under the program.
Explain why US enthusiasm for the program declined by the late 1960s.
Describe how the program was wound down by the early 1970s.
Use a raíz de to introduce the origin of a later change.
